decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8141. Series context: trend strength 0.1963 and seasonal strength 0.0257; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.267); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.396.
